sentences.zh: 其上元七曜，起赤道虛四度。

translations.literal: Its upper origin for the seven luminaries begins at four degrees of equatorial Xū.
translations.idiomatic: Its upper origin for the seven luminaries starts at equatorial Xū 4°.

sentences.zh: 景福元年，曆成，賜名崇玄。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingfu the calendar was completed and granted the name Chongxuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingfu year 1 the calendar was finished and named Chongxuan.

sentences.zh: 氣朔、發斂、盈縮、朓朒、定朔弦望、九道月度、交會、入蝕限去交前後，皆大衍之舊。

translations.literal: Qi and new moons, issuing-and-gathering-in, surplus-deficit, waxing-and-waning, fixed new moon and quarter moons, nine-path monthly degree, syzygies, and eclipse-limit distance before and after conjunction—all follow the old Dayan.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, new moons, issuing-and-gathering-in, surplus-deficit, waxing-and-waning, fixed syzygies, nine-path lunar position, conjunctions, and eclipse limits all follow Dayan.

sentences.zh: 餘雖不同，亦殊塗而至者。

translations.literal: The remainder differs, yet it is the same arrival by another path.
translations.idiomatic: The rest differs, yet the same end is reached by another route.

translations.literal: The divination solid is called the year solid.
The stalk method is called the new-moon solid.
The divination of the three origins is called the qi divination.
The divination of four images is called the mean conjunction.
The divination of one image is called the quarter divination.
The hanging limit is called the intercalation limit.
translations.idiomatic: The hanging limit is termed the intercalation limit.

translations.literal: The line number is called the cycle method.
translations.idiomatic: The line number is termed the cycle method.

translations.literal: The divination remainder is called the year remainder.
The divination at heaven's center is called the hou divination.
The divination at earth's center is called the hexagram divination.
The divination of true and changing lines is called the earth-kingship divination.
The chen method is half the chen method.
translations.idiomatic: The chen method is half the chen method.

translations.literal: The Qian solid is called the circuit-of-heaven parts.
Surplus-deficit and waxing-and-waning all use regular qi.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus-deficit and waxing-and-waning all use regular qi.

translations.literal: Surplus-deficit parts are called ascent and descent.
Prior and posterior are called surplus-deficit.

sentences.zh: 凡升降、損益，皆進一等，倍象統乘之，除法而一，為平行率。

translations.literal: For all ascent-descent and decrease-increase, advance one rank, double the image-tally multiplier, divide by the divisor, and take one—this is the mean rate.
translations.idiomatic: For ascent-descent and decrease-increase, advance one rank, double the image tally, divide once—mean rate.

translations.literal: Subtract from the posterior rate to obtain the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the posterior rate for the difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，以加減平行率，為初、末率。

translations.literal: Halve it and add or subtract to the mean rate for initial and final rates.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it; add or subtract to the mean rate for initial and final rates.

sentences.zh: 倍差，進一等，以象統乘之，除法而一，為日差。

translations.literal: Double the difference, advance one rank, multiply by the image tally, divide by the divisor, and take one—this is the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the difference, advance one rank, multiply by the image tally, divide once for the daily difference.

translations.literal: Add and subtract to initial and final to obtain the fixed value.
translations.idiomatic: Add and subtract initial and final for the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 以日差累加減，為每日分。

translations.literal: Accumulate add and subtract by the daily difference for the daily parts.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate daily difference add/subtract for daily parts.

sentences.zh: 凡小餘，皆萬乘之，通法除，為約餘，則以萬為法。

translations.literal: For all minor remainders, multiply by ten thousand; divide by the common divisor for reduced remainder, taking ten thousand as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For all minor remainders, multiply by 10,000; divide by the common divisor for reduced remainder, with 10,000 as divisor.

sentences.zh: 又以百約之，為大分，則以百為法。

translations.literal: Also reduce by one hundred for major parts, taking one hundred as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Also reduce by 100 for major parts, with 100 as divisor.

sentences.zh: 凡冬至赤道日度及約餘，以減其宿全度，乃累加次宿，皆為距後積度。

translations.literal: For winter solstice equatorial solar degree and reduced remainder, subtract from the lodge's full degree, then accumulate the next lodges—all are accumulated degree after distance.
translations.idiomatic: From winter-solstice equatorial degree and reduced remainder, subtract lodge full degrees and accumulate successive lodges for post-distance accumulation.

sentences.zh: 滿限九十一度三十一分三十七小分，去之。

translations.literal: When it fills the limit of ninety-one degrees thirty-one parts thirty-seven minor parts, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the limit 91°31′37″, remove it.

translations.literal: If the remainder is at or below half, it is initial;
translations.idiomatic: Remainder at or below half: initial;

translations.literal: if above, subtract from the limit for final.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from the limit for final.

sentences.zh: 皆百四十四乘之，退一等，以減千三百一十五。

translations.literal: All multiply by one hundred forty-four, retreat one rank, and subtract one thousand three hundred fifteen.

sentences.zh: 所得以乘初、末度分，為差。

translations.literal: Multiply initial and final degree-parts by the result for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply initial and final degree-parts by the result for the difference.

sentences.zh: 又通初、末度分，與四千五百六十六先相減、後相乘，千六百九十除之，以減差，為定差，再退為分。

translations.literal: Also convert initial and final degree-parts; first subtract then multiply with four thousand five hundred sixty-six, divide by one thousand six hundred ninety to subtract from the difference for fixed difference, retreating again for parts.
translations.idiomatic: Convert initial and final degree-parts; subtract then multiply with 4,566, divide by 1,690 to subtract from the difference for fixed difference, retreat again for parts.

sentences.zh: 至後以減、分後以加距後積度，為黃道積度。

translations.literal: After the solstice subtract; after the equinox add to post-distance accumulation for yellow-path accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: After solstice subtract; after equinox add to post-distance accumulation for yellow-path accumulation.

translations.literal: Subtract successive lodges to obtain the degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract successive lodges for the degree.

sentences.zh: 以冬至赤道日度及約餘，依前求定差以減之，為黃道日度。

translations.literal: Take winter solstice equatorial solar degree and reduced remainder, seek the fixed difference as before and subtract, for yellow-path solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: From winter-solstice equatorial degree and reduced remainder, subtract the fixed difference as before for yellow-path solar degree.

sentences.zh: 凡歲差，十一乘之，又以所求氣數乘之，三千八百八十八而一，以加前氣中積；

translations.literal: For all precession, multiply by eleven, also multiply by the qi number sought, divide by three thousand eight hundred eighty-eight and add to the prior qi central accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Precession: ×11, also × the qi sought, ÷3,888, add to prior qi central accumulation;

sentences.zh: 又以盈縮分盈加、縮減之，命以冬至宿度，即其氣初加時宿度。

translations.literal: Also where surplus add and deficit subtract surplus-deficit parts; count from the winter-solstice lodge degree for the qi's initial added-time lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add surplus and subtract deficit from surplus-deficit parts; count from winter-solstice lodge for qi initial added-time lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 其定朔小餘，如日法四十分之二十九已上，以定朔小餘減日法，餘如晨初餘數已下，進一日。

translations.literal: If the fixed-new-moon minor remainder is twenty-nine fortieths of the day divisor or above, subtract the day divisor from the fixed-new-moon minor remainder; if the remainder is at or below the morning-initial remainder number, advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: If fixed-new-moon minor remainder ≥ 29/40 of the day divisor, subtract the day divisor; if remainder ≤ morning-initial remainder, advance one day.

sentences.zh: 岡又作徑術求黃道月度。

translations.literal: Gang also devised a direct method to seek yellow-path monthly degree.
translations.idiomatic: Gang also used a direct method to find yellow-path monthly degree.

translations.literal: Remove what fills the obscuration rate from accumulated years for obscuration cycles.
translations.idiomatic: Remove obscuration rate from accumulated years for obscuration cycles.

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is obscuration remainder.
Multiply obscuration remainder by year remainder and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply obscuration remainder by year remainder and set aside.

sentences.zh: 二因蔀周，三十七除之，以減副。

translations.literal: Double obscuration cycles, divide by thirty-seven, and subtract from the aside.
translations.idiomatic: Double obscuration cycles, divide by 37, subtract from aside.

sentences.zh: 百一十九約蔀餘，以加副。

translations.literal: Reduce obscuration remainder by one hundred nineteen and add to the aside.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce obscuration remainder by 119 and add to the aside.

translations.literal: Remove what fills the circuit of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Remove what fills the circuit of heaven.

sentences.zh: 餘，四因之為分，度母而一為度，即冬至加時平行月。

translations.literal: The remainder: quadruple for parts; divide once by the degree mother for degrees—this is winter-solstice added-time mean Moon.
translations.idiomatic: Remainder: ×4 for parts; ÷ degree mother once for degrees—winter-solstice added-time mean Moon.

sentences.zh: 又以冬至約餘距午前後分，二百五十四乘之，萬約為分，度母為度；

translations.literal: Also take winter-solstice reduced remainder distance before and after noon, multiply by two hundred fifty-four, reduce by ten thousand for parts, degree mother for degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Winter-solstice reduced remainder noon distance ×254; ÷10,000 for parts; degree mother for degrees;

sentences.zh: 午前以加、午後以減加時月，為午中月。

translations.literal: Before noon add and after noon subtract from added-time Moon for noon-center Moon.
translations.idiomatic: Before noon add, after noon subtract from added-time Moon for noon-center Moon.

sentences.zh: 自此計日平行十三度十九分度之七。

translations.literal: From here count days: mean motion thirteen degrees and seven parts of a degree.
translations.idiomatic: From here count days: mean motion 13° 7′.

sentences.zh: 自冬至距定朔，累以平行減之，為定朔午中月。

translations.literal: From winter solstice to fixed new moon, accumulate subtracting mean motion for fixed-new-moon noon-center Moon.
translations.idiomatic: From winter solstice to fixed new moon, accumulate subtracting mean motion for fixed-new-moon noon-center Moon.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及弦望，各計日以平行加之。

translations.literal: Seek the next new moon and quarter moons: for each count days and add mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: For next new moon and quarters, count days and add mean motion.

translations.literal: Divide the parts by the degree mother for reduced parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide parts by the degree mother for reduced parts.

sentences.zh: 又四十七除蔀餘，為率差。

translations.literal: Also divide obscuration remainder by forty-seven for rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also divide obscuration remainder by 47 for rate difference.

sentences.zh: 不盡，以乘七日三分半，副之。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted: multiply by seven days and three and a half parts, and set aside.

sentences.zh: 九因率差，退一等，為分，以減副。

translations.literal: Nine times rate difference, retreat one rank for parts, subtract from the aside.
translations.idiomatic: 9 × rate difference, retreat one rank for parts, subtract from aside.

sentences.zh: 又百約冬至加時距午分，午前加之，午後減之，滿轉周去之，即冬至午中入轉。

translations.literal: Also reduce winter-solstice added-time distance-from-noon parts by one hundred; before noon add, after noon subtract; remove what fills the rotation cycle—this is winter-solstice noon-center entering rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce winter-solstice added-time noon distance by 100; before noon add, after noon subtract; remove rotation cycle for winter-solstice noon-center entering rotation.

sentences.zh: 以冬至距朔日減之，即定朔午中入轉。

translations.literal: Subtract days from winter solstice to new moon for fixed-new-moon noon-center entering rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract winter-solstice-to-new-moon days for fixed-new-moon noon-center entering rotation.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及弦望，計日加之。

translations.literal: Seek the next new moon and quarter moons: count days and add.
translations.idiomatic: For next new moon and quarters, count days and add.

sentences.zh: 各以所入日下損益率乘轉餘，百而一，以損益盈縮積，為定差。

translations.literal: For each, multiply rotation remainder by the decrease-increase rate below the day entered, divide by one hundred, and decrease-increase the surplus-deficit accumulation for fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Each day: rotation remainder × that day's decrease-increase rate ÷100; adjust surplus-deficit accumulation for fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 以盈加、縮減午中月，為定月。

translations.literal: Where surplus add and deficit subtract to noon-center Moon for fixed Moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add surplus and subtract deficit to noon-center Moon for fixed Moon.

sentences.zh: 以月行定分乘其日晨昏距午分，萬約為分，滿百為度，以減午中定月，為晨月；

translations.literal: Multiply fixed daily lunar motion by that day's morning and evening distance-from-noon parts, reduce by ten thousand for parts; what fills one hundred is degrees—subtract from noon-center fixed Moon for morning Moon;
translations.idiomatic: Fixed lunar motion × morning/evening noon distance ÷10,000; ÷100 for degrees; subtract from noon fixed Moon for morning Moon;

sentences.zh: 以朔昏月減上弦昏月，以上弦昏月減望昏月，以望晨月減下弦晨月，以下弦晨月減後朔晨月，各為定程。

translations.literal: New-moon evening Moon minus first-quarter evening Moon, first-quarter evening minus full-moon evening, full-moon morning minus last-quarter morning, last-quarter morning minus next new-moon morning—each is a fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: Differences between syzygy/quarter evening and morning Moons give each fixed interval.

sentences.zh: 以相距日均，為平行度分。

translations.literal: Average the interval days for mean motion degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Average interval days for mean motion degree-parts.

translations.literal: Subtract the next interval for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the next interval for the difference.

sentences.zh: 以加、減平行，為初、末日定行。

translations.literal: Add and subtract to mean motion for initial- and final-day fixed motion.
translations.idiomatic: Add and subtract to mean motion for initial- and final-day fixed motion.

translations.literal: If the next is smaller, add for initial and subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: If the next is smaller, add initial and subtract final.

translations.literal: If the next is larger, subtract for initial and add for final.
translations.idiomatic: If the next is larger, subtract initial and add final.

sentences.zh: 減相距日一，均差，為日差。

translations.literal: Subtract one from interval days and average the difference for daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one from interval days; average the difference for daily difference.

sentences.zh: 累損、益初日，為每日定行。

translations.literal: Accumulate decrease and increase from the first day for daily fixed motion.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate decrease and increase from day one for daily fixed motion.

translations.literal: If the next is larger, accumulate increase.
translations.idiomatic: If the next is larger, accumulate increase.

translations.literal: If the next is smaller, accumulate decrease.
translations.idiomatic: If the next is smaller, accumulate decrease.

sentences.zh: 因朔弦望晨昏月，累加之，得每日晨昏月。

translations.literal: Starting from syzygy and quarter morning and evening Moons, accumulate add to obtain daily morning and evening Moons.
translations.idiomatic: From syzygy/quarter morning and evening Moons, accumulate to daily morning and evening Moons.

sentences.zh: 各計其日中入二至加時已來日數及餘。

translations.literal: For each, count days and remainder from added time at the solstice entering the day to its noon.
translations.idiomatic: For each, count days and remainder from solstice added time to that day's noon.

translations.literal: If at or below the initial limit, it is posterior;
translations.idiomatic: At or below the initial limit: posterior;

sentences.zh: 已上，以減二至限，餘為前，副之。

translations.literal: if above, subtract from the solstice limit; the remainder is anterior—set aside.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from solstice limit; remainder is anterior—set aside.

sentences.zh: 各以乘數乘之，用減初、末差。

translations.literal: Multiply each by its multiplier and use to subtract initial and final differences.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each by its multiplier to subtract initial and final differences.

sentences.zh: 所得再乘其副，滿百萬為尺，不滿為寸、為分。

translations.literal: Multiply the result again by the aside; what fills one million is chi; what does not fill is cun and fen.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply again by the aside; one million fills a chi; remainder is cun and fen.

translations.literal: After summer solstice, retreat one rank.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, retreat one rank.

sentences.zh: 各至前後，以減冬至中晷；

translations.literal: Before and after each solstice, subtract from the winter-solstice noon gnomon;
translations.idiomatic: Before and after each solstice, subtract from winter-solstice noon gnomon;

sentences.zh: 夏至前後，以加夏至中晷：為每日陽城中晷。

translations.literal: before and after summer solstice, add to the summer-solstice noon gnomon: the daily Yang-city noon gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: before and after summer solstice, add to summer-solstice noon gnomon: daily Yang-city noon gnomon.

sentences.zh: 與次日相減，後多曰息，後少曰消。

translations.literal: Subtract the next day; if the next is larger it is called breath-increase, if smaller breath-decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the next day; larger next: breath-increase; smaller: breath-decrease.

sentences.zh: 以冬夏至午前、後約分乘之，萬而一，午前息減、消加，午後息加、消減中晷，為定數也。

translations.literal: Multiply by winter- and summer-solstice before- and after-noon reduced parts; divide by ten thousand; before noon breath-increase subtract and breath-decrease add, after noon breath-increase add and breath-decrease subtract from noon gnomon for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: × solstice before/after-noon reduced parts ÷10,000; before/after noon rules on breath and gnomon for fixed number.

translations.literal: For the first day of winter solstice, there is subtraction but no addition.
translations.idiomatic: Winter-solstice day one: subtract only, no add.

translations.literal: For the first day of summer solstice, there is addition but no subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Summer-solstice day one: add only, no subtract.

sentences.zh: 又計二至加時已來至其日昏後夜半日數及餘。

translations.literal: Also count days and remainder from solstice added time to that day's after dusk and midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Also count days and remainder from solstice added time to that day's after dusk and midnight.

sentences.zh: 冬至後為息，夏至後為消。

translations.literal: After winter solstice is breath-increase; after summer solstice is breath-decrease.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice: breath-increase; after summer solstice: breath-decrease.

translations.literal: If at or below one image, it is initial;
translations.idiomatic: At or below one image: initial;

sentences.zh: 已上，反減二至限，餘為末。

translations.literal: if above, inversely subtract from the solstice limit; the remainder is final.
translations.idiomatic: if above, inversely subtract from solstice limit; remainder is final.

sentences.zh: 令自相乘，進二位，以消息法除為分，副之。

translations.literal: Let it self-multiply, advance two ranks, divide by the breath message method for parts, and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Self-multiply, advance two ranks, divide by breath-message method for parts, set aside.

sentences.zh: 與五百分先相減，後相乘，千八百而一，以加副，為消息數。

translations.literal: First subtract five hundred parts, then multiply, divide by one thousand eight hundred and add to the aside for the breath message number.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 500, multiply, ÷1800, add to aside for breath message number.

sentences.zh: 以象積乘之，百約為分，再退為度。

translations.literal: Multiply by image accumulation, reduce by one hundred for parts, retreat again for degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by image accumulation; reduce by 100 for parts; retreat again for degrees.

sentences.zh: 春分後，以加六十七度四十分，秋分後，以減百一十五度二十分，即各其日黃道去極。

translations.literal: After spring equinox add sixty-seven degrees forty parts; after autumn equinox subtract one hundred fifteen degrees twenty parts—for each day yellow-path departure from pole.
translations.idiomatic: After spring equinox +67°40′; after autumn equinox −115°20′ for daily yellow-path polar distance.

sentences.zh: 與一象相減，則赤道內外也。

translations.literal: Subtract one image and it is inside or outside the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one image for inside or outside the equator.

sentences.zh: 以消息數，春分後加千七百五十二，秋分後以減二千七百四十八，即各其日晷漏母也。

translations.literal: With the breath message number, after spring equinox add one thousand seven hundred fifty-two; after autumn equinox subtract two thousand seven hundred forty-eight—for each day's gnomon-clepsydra mother.
translations.idiomatic: Breath message: after spring equinox +1752; after autumn equinox −2748 for daily gnomon-clepsydra mother.

sentences.zh: 以減五千，為晨昏距午分。

translations.literal: Subtract from five thousand for morning and evening distance-from-noon parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 5,000 for morning and evening distance-from-noon parts.

sentences.zh: 置晷漏母，千四百六十一乘，而再半之。

translations.literal: Set the gnomon-clepsydra mother, multiply by one thousand four hundred sixty-one, and halve again.
Reduce by one hundred for distance-from-zi degrees.

sentences.zh: 以減半周天，餘為距中度。

translations.literal: Subtract from half the circuit of heaven; the remainder is distance-from-center degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from half the circuit of heaven; remainder is distance-from-center degrees.

sentences.zh: 百三十五乘晷漏母，百約為分，得晨初餘數。

translations.literal: For gnomon-clepsydra, one hundred makes one quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 不滿，以象積乘之，百約為分，得夜半定漏。

translations.literal: one hundred; zero and a half

sentences.zh: 九服中晷，各於其地立表候之。

translations.literal: Mid-gnomon at the nine domains: at each place set up the gnomon and observe.
translations.idiomatic: Nine-domain mid-gnomon: set up the gnomon and observe at each place.

sentences.zh: 在陽城北，冬至前候晷景與陽城冬至同者，為差日之始；

translations.literal: North of Yang-city, before winter solstice when the gnomon shadow matches Yang-city winter solstice, that is the start of the difference day;
translations.idiomatic: North of Yang-city, before winter solstice when the shadow matches Yang-city winter solstice: difference-day start;

sentences.zh: 在陽城南，夏至前候晷景與陽城夏至同者，為差日之始。

translations.literal: South of Yang-city, before summer solstice when the gnomon shadow matches Yang-city summer solstice, that is the start of the difference day.
translations.idiomatic: South of Yang-city, before summer solstice when the shadow matches Yang-city summer solstice: difference-day start.

sentences.zh: 自差日之始，至二至日，為距差日數也。

translations.literal: From the difference-day start to the solstice day is the count of days from the difference.
translations.idiomatic: From difference-day start to solstice: days from difference.

sentences.zh: 在至前者，計距前已來日數；

translations.literal: Before the solstice, count days elapsed since before the distance;
translations.idiomatic: Before solstice: count days since prior distance;

sentences.zh: 至後者，計入至後已來日數。

translations.literal: After the solstice, count days elapsed since entering after the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: After solstice: count days since entering after solstice.

sentences.zh: 反減距差日，餘為距後日準。

translations.literal: Inversely subtract distance-difference days; the remainder is the post-distance day standard.
translations.idiomatic: Inversely subtract distance-difference days; remainder is post-distance day standard.

sentences.zh: 求初、末限晷差，各冬至前後以加、夏至前後以減冬夏至陽城中晷，得其地其日中晷。

translations.literal: Seek initial and final limit gnomon differences: before and after winter solstice add, before and after summer solstice subtract from Yang-city solstice noon gnomons, obtaining that place's noon gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Seek initial/final limit gnomon differences: add/subtract Yang-city solstice noon gnomons for local noon gnomon.

sentences.zh: 若不足減，減去夏至陽城中晷，即其日南倒中晷也。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, subtract from the summer-solstice Yang-city noon gnomon—then that day's south-inverted noon gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient, subtract from summer-solstice Yang-city noon gnomon for south-inverted noon gnomon.

sentences.zh: 自餘之日，各計冬夏至後所求日數。

translations.literal: For the remaining days, each counts days after the winter or summer solstice sought.
translations.idiomatic: Other days: count days after the solstice sought.

sentences.zh: 減去距冬夏至差日，餘準初、末限入之。

translations.literal: Subtract distance-from-solstice difference days; the remainder enters initial and final limits.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract distance-from-solstice difference days; remainder enters initial/final limits.

sentences.zh: 又九服所在，各於其地置水漏，以定二至夜刻，為漏率。

translations.literal: Also at each of the nine domains' locations, set up a water clepsydra at that place to fix solstice night quarter-hours, as the clepsydra rate.
translations.idiomatic: At each nine-domain location, set a water clepsydra to fix solstice night quarter-hours as clepsydra rate.

sentences.zh: 以漏率乘每日晷漏母，各以陽城二至晷漏母除之，得其地每日晷漏母。

translations.literal: Multiply daily gnomon-clepsydra mother by clepsydra rate; each divides by Yang-city solstice gnomon-clepsydra mother for that place's daily gnomon-clepsydra mother.
translations.idiomatic: Daily gnomon-clepsydra mother × clepsydra rate ÷ Yang-city solstice mother for local daily mother.

sentences.zh: 以四百一乘朔望加時入交常日及約餘，三十除，為度；

translations.literal: Multiply syzygy added-time entering-conjunction regular days and reduced remainder by four hundred one; divide by thirty for degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Syzygy added-time entering-conjunction regular days and reduced remainder ×401, ÷30 for degrees;

sentences.zh: 不滿退除為分，得定朔望入交定積度分。

translations.literal: What does not fill: retreat and divide for parts, obtaining fixed new and full moon entering-conjunction fixed accumulated degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Remainder: retreat-divide for parts for fixed syzygy entering-conjunction accumulated degree-parts.

sentences.zh: 以減周天，命起朔望加時黃道日躔，即交所在宿次。

translations.literal: Subtract from the circuit of heaven; count from syzygy added-time yellow-path solar pacing—this is the lodge of conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from circuit of heaven; count from syzygy added-time solar pacing for conjunction lodge.

sentences.zh: 凡入交定積度，如半交已上，為在陽曆；

translations.literal: For all entering-conjunction fixed accumulated degree, if at or above half-conjunction, it is in the yang half;
translations.idiomatic: Entering-conjunction fixed accumulation at or above half-conjunction: yang half;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半交，餘為入陰曆。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half-conjunction; the remainder is entering the yin half.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract half-conjunction; remainder enters yin half.

sentences.zh: 以定朔望約餘乘轉分，萬約為分，滿百為度；
以減入陰、陽曆積度，為定朔望夜半所入。

translations.literal: Subtract from entering yin- and yang-half accumulated degree for fixed syzygy midnight entry.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from yin/yang accumulated degree for fixed syzygy midnight entry.

translations.literal: If at or below one image, it is in the minor image;
translations.idiomatic: At or below one image: minor image;

sentences.zh: 已上者，反減半交，餘為入老象。

translations.literal: if above, inversely subtract half-conjunction; the remainder is entering the major image.
translations.idiomatic: if above, inversely subtract half-conjunction; remainder: major image.

sentences.zh: 用減千三百二十四，餘以乘老、少象度及餘，再退為分，副之。

translations.literal: Subtract one thousand three hundred twenty-four; multiply major and minor image degrees and remainder by the remainder, retreat twice for parts, and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 1,324; multiply major/minor image degrees by remainder; retreat twice for parts; set aside.

sentences.zh: 在少象三十度已下，老象六十一度已上，皆與九十一度先相減、後相乘，五十六除，為差。
若少象三十度已上，反減九十一度，及老象六十度已下，皆自相乘，百五除，為差。

translations.literal: thirty; ninety-one; sixty; one hundred five

sentences.zh: 皆以減副，百約為度，即朔望夜半月去黃道度分。

translations.literal: one hundred; zero and a half

sentences.zh: 凡定朔約餘距午前、後分，與五千先相減、後相乘，三萬除之；

translations.literal: For all fixed new-moon approximate remainders' distance from noon before and after parts, with 5,000 first subtract, then multiply, divide by 30,000;
translations.idiomatic: For the fixed new moon's approximate remainder measured before and after noon, subtract from 5,000 first, then multiply, and divide by 30,000;

sentences.zh: 午前以減，午後倍之，以加約餘，為日蝕定餘。

translations.literal: Before noon subtract; after noon double and add to reduced remainder for solar eclipse fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Before noon subtract; after noon double and add to reduced remainder for solar eclipse fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 定望約餘，即為月蝕定餘。

translations.literal: Fixed full-moon reduced remainder is the lunar eclipse fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed full-moon reduced remainder is lunar eclipse fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 晨初餘數已下者，皆四百乘之，以晨初餘數除之，所得以加定望約餘，為或蝕小餘。

translations.literal: If at or below morning-initial remainder number, all multiply by four hundred; divide by morning-initial remainder number; add the result to fixed full-moon reduced remainder for possible-eclipse minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: At or below morning-initial remainder: ×400, ÷ morning-initial remainder, add to fixed full-moon reduced remainder for possible-eclipse minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 各以象統乘之，萬約，為半辰之數。

translations.literal: When the remainder fills two thousand four hundred, it is quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 不盡退除，為刻分，即其辰刻日蝕有差。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted: retreat and divide for quarter-hour parts—the hour-quarter of the solar eclipse offset.
translations.idiomatic: Remainder: retreat-divide for quarter-hour parts for eclipse hour offset.

sentences.zh: 置其朔距天正中氣積度，以減三百六十五度半，餘以千乘，滿三百六十五度半除為分，曰限心。

translations.literal: three hundred sixty-five; zero and a half; one thousand; three hundred sixty-five; zero and a half
Subtract two hundred fifty parts for limit tail.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，加減一千，退蝕定餘一等。
與限首、尾相近者，相減，餘為限內外分。

translations.literal: When near limit head and tail, subtract mutually; the remainder is inside-outside limit parts.
translations.idiomatic: Near limit head and tail: subtract; remainder is inside-outside limit parts.

sentences.zh: 其蝕定餘多於限首、少於限尾者，為外。

translations.literal: If eclipse fixed remainder is greater than limit head and less than limit tail, it is outside.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse fixed remainder > limit head and < limit tail: outside.

sentences.zh: 少於限首、多於限尾者，為內。

translations.literal: If less than limit head and greater than limit tail, it is inside.
translations.idiomatic: Less than limit head and greater than limit tail: inside.

sentences.zh: 在限內者，令限內分自乘，百七十九而一，以減六百三十，餘為陰曆蝕差。

translations.literal: one hundred seventy-nine; one; six hundred thirty

sentences.zh: 限外者，置限外分與五百先相減、後相乘，四百四十六而一，為陰曆蝕差。

translations.literal: five hundred; four hundred forty-six; one

sentences.zh: 又限內分亦與五百先相減，後相乘，三百一十三半而一，為陽曆蝕差。

translations.literal: five hundred; three hundred thirteen and a half; one

sentences.zh: 在限內者，以陽曆蝕差加陰曆蝕差，為既前法。

translations.literal: If inside the limit, add yang-half eclipse difference to yin-half eclipse difference for the pre-totality method.
translations.idiomatic: Inside limit: yang-half + yin-half eclipse difference for pre-totality method.

sentences.zh: 以減千四百八十，餘為既後法。

translations.literal: Subtract from one thousand four hundred eighty; the remainder is the post-totality method.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 1,480; remainder is post-totality method.

sentences.zh: 在限外者，以六百一十分為既前法，八百八十分為既後法。

translations.literal: If outside the limit, use 610 as the pre-totality divisor and 880 as the post-totality divisor.
translations.idiomatic: When outside the limit, take 610 as the pre-totality divisor and 880 as the post-totality divisor.

sentences.zh: 其去交度分，在限外陰曆者，以陰曆差減之。

translations.literal: Distance-from-conjunction degree-parts in outside-limit yin half: subtract yin-half difference.
translations.idiomatic: Outside-limit yin half: subtract yin-half difference from distance-from-conjunction.

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient to subtract: no eclipse.

translations.literal: Also outside the limit there is no yang half.

sentences.zh: 交在限內陰曆者，以陽曆蝕差加之。

translations.literal: Conjunction inside limit in yin half: add yang-half eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: Inside limit yin half: add yang-half eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 若在限內陽曆者，以去交度分反減陽曆蝕差。

translations.literal: If inside limit in yang half, inversely subtract yang-half eclipse difference from distance-from-conjunction degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Inside limit yang half: inversely subtract yang-half difference from distance-from-conjunction.

translations.literal: If insufficient to inversely subtract, no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient to inversely subtract: no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 如既前法已下者，為既前分。

translations.literal: If at or below the pre-totality method, it is pre-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: At or below pre-totality method: pre-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 已上者，以減千四百八十，餘為既後分。

translations.literal: If above, subtract from one thousand four hundred eighty; the remainder is post-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract from 1,480; remainder is post-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 各以既前、後法除，為蝕分。

translations.literal: Each divides by pre- and post-totality methods for eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by pre/post-totality methods for eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 在既後者，其虧復陰曆也。

translations.literal: In post-totality, its waning and recovery is yin half.
translations.idiomatic: Post-totality: waning and recovery is yin half.

sentences.zh: 凡朔望月行定分，日以九百乘，月以千乘，如千三百三十七而一，日以減千八百，月以減二千，餘為汎用刻分。

translations.literal: nine hundred; one thousand; one thousand three hundred thirty-seven; one; one thousand eight hundred; two thousand

sentences.zh: 凡月蝕汎用刻，在陽曆以三十四乘，在陰曆以四十一乘，百約，為月蝕既限。

translations.literal: For all lunar eclipses the general-use quarter-hours: in the yang month multiply by 34, in the yin month multiply by 41, approximate by 100, obtaining the lunar-eclipse totality limit.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses generally, multiply by 34 in a yang month and by 41 in a yin month, reduce by 100, and obtain the totality limit for a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以減千四百八十，餘為月蝕定法。

translations.literal: Subtract from one thousand four hundred eighty; the remainder is the lunar eclipse fixed method.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 1,480; remainder is lunar eclipse fixed method.

sentences.zh: 其去交度分，如既限已下者，既。

translations.literal: Distance-from-conjunction degree-parts at or below totality limit: totality.
translations.idiomatic: Distance-from-conjunction at or below totality limit: totality.

sentences.zh: 已上者，以減千四百八十，餘進一位，以定法約，為蝕分。

translations.literal: If above, subtract from 1,480; advance the remainder one place; approximate by the fixed divisor, obtaining the eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: If above that value, subtract from 1,480, carry the remainder one place, divide by the fixed divisor, and obtain the eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 其蝕五分已下者，為或食；

translations.literal: If eclipse parts are five tenths or below, it is a possible eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse parts ≤ five tenths: possible eclipse;

sentences.zh: 凡日月食分，汎用刻乘之，千而一，為定用刻。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted: retreat and divide for quarter-hour parts.
For totality, take the general as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Totality: take the general as fixed.

sentences.zh: 各以減蝕甚約餘，為虧初。

translations.literal: Each subtracts from eclipse maximum reduced remainder for waning initial.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from eclipse maximum reduced remainder for waning initial.

sentences.zh: 凡蝕甚與晨昏分相近，如定用刻已下者，因相減，餘以乘蝕分，滿定用刻而一，所得以減蝕分，得帶蝕分。

translations.literal: When eclipse maximum is near morning and evening parts, if at or below fixed-use quarter-hours, subtract mutually; multiply the remainder by eclipse parts, divide once by fixed-use quarter-hours, subtract from eclipse parts for carried eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: When eclipse maximum nears morning/evening parts and ≤ fixed-use quarter-hours: adjust eclipse parts for carried eclipse parts.

translations.literal: Five-planet mutation difference is called year difference.
Yin-yang advance-retreat difference is called surplus-deficit.
Line calculation is called stroke degree.
Strokes are twelve—also the line number.
translations.idiomatic: Strokes are twelve—also the line number.

sentences.zh: 推冬至後加時平合日算，曰平合中積。

translations.literal: Push added-time mean conjunction day tally after winter solstice, called mean-conjunction central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Push added-time mean conjunction after winter solstice: mean-conjunction central accumulation.

translations.literal: Year difference subtracts central star, called entering the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Year difference subtracts central star: entering the calendar.

translations.literal: Where there is remainder, all reduce.

sentences.zh: 因平合以諸變常積日加中積，常積度加中星、入曆，各其變中積、中星、入曆也。

translations.literal: From mean conjunction, add regular accumulated days to central accumulation and regular accumulated degrees to central star and entering calendar—for each mutation's central accumulation, central star, and entering calendar.
translations.idiomatic: From mean conjunction add regular accumulated days/degrees to central accumulation, star, and entering calendar for each mutation.

translations.literal: For all entering-calendar surplus limit at or below, it is surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Entering calendar at or below surplus limit: surplus.

translations.literal: If above, remove it for deficit.

sentences.zh: 各如畫度分而一，命畫數算外。

translations.literal: Each divide once by stroke degree-parts; count outside the stroke tally.
translations.idiomatic: Each ÷ stroke degree-parts once; count outside stroke tally.

sentences.zh: 不滿，以畫下損益乘之，畫度分除之，以損益盈縮積，為定差。

translations.literal: What does not fill: multiply by decrease-increase below the stroke, divide by stroke degree-parts, decrease-increase surplus-deficit accumulation for fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Remainder: × decrease-increase below stroke, ÷ stroke degree-parts, adjust surplus-deficit accumulation for fixed difference.

translations.literal: Where surplus add and deficit subtract to central accumulation for fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus add, deficit subtract to central accumulation for fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 準求所入氣及月日，加冬至大餘及約餘，為其變大小餘。

translations.literal: Align to seek qi and month-day entered; add winter-solstice major remainder and reduced remainder for that mutation's major and minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: Seek qi and month-day; add winter-solstice major and reduced remainders for mutation major/minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 以命日辰，則變行所在也。

translations.literal: Count day and double-hour and the mutation motion's place is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Count day and double-hour for mutation motion place.

sentences.zh: 亦以盈加、縮減中星，應用躔差。

translations.literal: Also surplus add and deficit subtract to central star, applying pacing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also adjust central star with surplus/deficit, applying pacing difference.

sentences.zh: 視定積如半交已下，為在盈；

translations.literal: View fixed accumulation at or below half-conjunction as in surplus;
translations.idiomatic: Fixed accumulation at or below half-conjunction: in surplus;

translations.literal: if above, remove for in deficit.

sentences.zh: 所得，令半交度先相減、後相乘，三千四百三十五除，為度。

translations.literal: The product obtained: let the half-crossing degree first subtract, then multiply, divide by 3,435, obtaining degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Take the result, let the half-crossing degree subtract first and then multiply, divide by 3,435, and obtain the degree value.

sentences.zh: 不盡退除為分者，亦盈加、縮減之。

translations.literal: Where retreat-dividing for parts does not exhaust, also surplus add and deficit subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Remainder retreat-divided for parts: also surplus add and deficit subtract.

sentences.zh: 其變異術者，從其術，各為定星。

translations.literal: If the mutation uses a special method, follow that method; each becomes fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Special mutation methods: follow each; fixed star.

sentences.zh: 命起冬至黃道日躔，得其變行加時所在宿度也。

translations.literal: Count from winter-solstice yellow-path solar pacing to obtain that mutation's added-time lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Count from winter-solstice yellow-path solar pacing for mutation added-time lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 凡辰星依曆變置算，乃視晨見、晨順在冬至後，夕見、夕順在夏至後計中積去二至九十一日半已下，令自乘。

translations.literal: For Mercury, set the tally according to the calendar mutations; then if morning appearance and morning direct are after winter solstice, or evening appearance and evening direct after summer solstice, count central accumulation from the solstice—if ninety-one days and a half or below, let it self-multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury: set tally per calendar mutations; if morning/evening appearance and direct fall after the relevant solstice and central accumulation from solstice is ≤91½ days, self-multiply.

sentences.zh: 已上，以減百八十二日半，亦自乘。

translations.literal: one hundred eighty-two; zero and a half

sentences.zh: 以加晨夕見中積、中星，減晨夕順中積、中星，各為應見不見中積、中星也。

translations.literal: Add to evening and morning appearance central accumulation and star; subtract from evening and morning direct central accumulation and star—for should-see and should-not-see central accumulation and star.
translations.idiomatic: Add/subtract to evening/morning appearance vs direct central accumulation and star for visibility.

sentences.zh: 凡盈縮定差，熒惑晨見變六十一乘之、五十四除之，乃為定差。

translations.literal: For all surplus-deficit fixed difference, Mars morning-appearance mutation: multiply by sixty-one and divide by fifty-four for the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus-deficit fixed difference: Mars morning-appearance mutation ×61 ÷54 for fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 太白、辰星再合，則半其差。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury at second conjunction, halve the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mercury at second conjunction: halve the difference.

sentences.zh: 其在夕見、晨疾二變，則盈減、縮加。

translations.literal: In evening appearance and morning fast two mutations, surplus subtract and deficit add.
translations.idiomatic: Evening appearance and morning fast mutations: surplus subtract, deficit add.

sentences.zh: 凡歲、鎮、熒惑留退，皆用前遲入曆定差。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars station and retrograde, all use prior slow entering-calendar fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter, Saturn, Mars station/retrograde: use prior slow entering-calendar fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 又各視前遲定星，以變下減度減之。

translations.literal: Also for each view prior slow fixed star, subtract the decrease-degree below the mutation.
translations.idiomatic: Each view prior slow fixed star; subtract decrease-degree below mutation.

translations.literal: Remainder at or below half-conjunction is surplus;
translations.idiomatic: Remainder at or below half-conjunction: surplus;

sentences.zh: 又視之，七十三已下三因之，已上減半交，餘二因之，為差。

translations.literal: seventy-three; three; zero and a half; two
In posterior retrograde, again double the difference.
All that fill one hundred become degrees.

sentences.zh: 以盈加、縮減中積，又以前遲定差盈加、縮減，乃為留退定積。

translations.literal: Surplus add and deficit subtract to central accumulation, also prior slow fixed difference surplus add and deficit subtract—for station-retrograde fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust central accumulation and prior slow fixed difference for station-retrograde fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其前後退中星，則以差縮加、盈減，又以前遲定差盈加、縮減，乃為退行定星。

translations.literal: For prior and posterior retrograde central star, deficit add and surplus subtract to the difference, also prior slow fixed difference surplus add and deficit subtract—for retrograde fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust prior/posterior retrograde central star with difference and prior slow fixed difference for retrograde fixed star.

sentences.zh: 凡諸變定星迭相減，為日度率。

translations.literal: For all mutations, fixed stars subtract in succession for day-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Successive fixed-star subtraction gives day-degree rate.

sentences.zh: 熒惑遲日盈六十、度盈二十四者，所盈日度加疾變日度，為定率。

translations.literal: For Mars slow days surplus sixty and degrees surplus twenty-four, add the surplussed days and degrees to the fast mutation's day-degrees for the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Mars slow days surplus 60 and degrees surplus 24: add surplussed days and degrees to fast mutation day-degrees for fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 太白退日率，百乘之，二百一十二除之、為留日。

translations.literal: Subtract from retrograde day rate for fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from retrograde day rate for fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 辰星退順日率一等，為留日。

translations.literal: Mercury retrograde direct day rate one rank is station days.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury retrograde direct day rate one rank: station days.

translations.literal: Subtract from direct day rate for fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from direct day rate for fixed rate.

translations.literal: Average daily degrees for mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: Average daily degrees for mean motion.

sentences.zh: 又與後變平行相減，為差。

translations.literal: Also subtract the next mutation's mean motion for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract next mutation's mean motion for difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，視後多少，以加減平行，為初、末日行分。

translations.literal: Halve it; view whether the next is larger or smaller to add and subtract to mean motion for initial- and final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Halve; add/subtract to mean motion for initial/final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以初日行分乘其變小餘，萬而一，順減、退加其變加時宿度，為夜半宿度。

translations.literal: Multiply the mutation's minor remainder by the first day's motion parts; divide by ten thousand; direct subtract and retrograde add to the mutation's added-time lodge degree for midnight lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: First-day motion parts × mutation minor remainder ÷10,000; direct subtract and retrograde add to mutation added-time lodge degree for midnight lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 又減日率一，均差，為日差。
